title: Question Formation: Sentence Builder
description: Construct questions by placing question words, auxiliary verbs, subjects, and main verbs in the right sequence.

thumbnail.alt: A stylish magnifying glass hovering over question mark puzzle pieces on a study desk
thumbnail.prompt: A stylish magnifying glass hovering over question mark puzzle pieces on a study desk. Flat vector illustration, soft warm earthy palette (terracotta, sage green, ochre, muted blue, cream) with a small touch of muted gold, very subtle, even paper grain, simple rounded shapes, gentle soft lighting, centered composition with generous empty space around the subject, mid-tone background that works on both dark and light pages. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no real or famous people, no watermark. Full-bleed flat background color from edge to edge: no frame, no border, no round or oval vignette, no wreath, no mandala or ornament in the middle of the image. aspect ratio 16:10

items.hint: Question word + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb.

items.sentence: What time does the lesson start?
items.translation: A que horas a aula começa?

items.sentence: Why are you studying English today?
items.translation: Por que você está estudando inglês hoje?

items.sentence: How many books do you read every month?
items.translation: Quantos livros você lê todo mês?

items.sentence: Can you help me with this exercise?
items.translation: Você pode me ajudar com este exercício?

items.sentence: When did they arrive at the station?
Who is waiting outside the door?
items.translation: Quem está esperando do lado de fora da porta?
